scope: Seven hosted U4 views and their shared navigation/component system; URLs, data contracts and actions are preserved.
designRead: Owner-facing developer platform: dense operational information, explicit evidence and calm navigation. Shadcnspace supplies interaction composition, while Guidefold keeps its graphite, teal/orange and compact geometry.
sourceAudit: Production /import showed an oversized clipped wordmark, decorative survey image in the sidebar, a flat seven-item hierarchy and large unused content width.
Shadcnspace Sidebar 01 contributed grouped navigation, collapsed icon mode, active-row treatment and an account footer. Its promo card and default skin were rejected.
Shadcnspace dashboard, Card, Accordion and Shine Border references supplied composition patterns, not product copy, invented data or a replacement palette.

componentMigration.BrandMark: Brand; account identity uses Base UI Avatar
componentMigration.PyramidChart: Lazy React Flow database schema cards, directed refines edges, Graph/List, zoom/fit, motion controls

explicitException: The owner explicitly requested Shadcnspace Shine Border, animated schema flows and Mintlify/Airuncode direction. Shine stays one-shot. The illustrative landing flow loops only while visible and may be paused; application flow is paused by default. Reduced motion disables both. Marketing changes live in the existing gf-waitlist-20260908 checkout alongside its waitlist implementation.

referenceContinuation.captures: references/; the initial incorrect schema demo capture was rejected and replaced with the actual registry component page.
referenceContinuation.decisions: Airuncode's centered headline and near-black surfaces; Mintlify's restrained green and explanatory connecting lines; xyflow's MIT schema-node header/table/handles. Original brand, API and truthful availability copy remain.
referenceContinuation.responsive: A narrow viewport focuses a readable selected schema card; step buttons preserve access to every workflow stage. Large application graphs focus the selected node and retain the complete List alternative.
referenceContinuation.limits: Illustrative animations are not transport telemetry. Combined landing and management UI deployed as Helm revision 4 on 2026-09-09; API remains unavailable due to pre-existing missing WorkOS key/client ID. See deployment-report.json.

supportingPatterns.favorites: Interactive Badge in Library and Skill, repeated in the row Context Menu; browser-persistent and isolated by user, organization and repository.
supportingPatterns.rating: Icon-led four-state control that preserves the API verdict domain instead of inventing a five-star score.
supportingPatterns.sonner: Short success/error confirmation for favorites, assessments and sign-out failure; critical and field-specific errors remain inline.

outOfScope: No eighth Editions route: editions remain revision history in Skill and Proposals.
